name: foreGASt
tagline: Forecasts agricultural price swings so farmers can hedge before they happen.

awards: Best Financial Hack - Sponsored by Capital One

problem: Farmers have few protections against seasonal price swings.
solution: An XGBoost model on public economic and energy data predicts price movements, shown in a dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: view a forecasted price spike.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Financial Hack - Sponsored by Capital One” among 231 submissions.
Inspired by a book on price hedging.

lessons: Bring financial tools to a group without them.
